components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; height: 7.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: var(--night, #0f1622); color: var(--night-text, #e8ecf2); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-track { position: absolute; left: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem; top: 4.5rem; height: 2px; background: var(--night-line, #263248); } .ds-elapsed { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(233 162 59 / 0.15), var(--sun, #e9a23b)); } .ds-now { position: absolute; top: 4.5rem; margin-left: 1.5rem; } .ds-now::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: -0.875rem; width: 2px; height: 1.875rem; background: var(--night-text, #e8ecf2); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-now span { position: absolute; top: 2.125rem; left: 0.5rem; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pin { position: absolute; top: 0.5rem; height: 4.5rem; margin-left: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-pin-label { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0 0 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--night-line, #263248); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--night-muted, #a5b0c1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pin-label b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pin i { width: 11px; height: 11px; margin: 0 0 -5px -5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--night, #0f1622); border: 2px solid var(--dusk, #5b6b82); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-pin.is-next i { background: var(--sun, #e9a23b); border-color: var(--sun, #e9a23b); outline: 1px solid var(--sun, #e9a23b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pin.is-next b { color: var(--sun, #e9a23b); } .ds-pin.is-next .ds-pin-label { color: var(--night-text, #e8ecf2); border-color: rgb(233 162 59 / 0.5); } .ds-hours { position: absolute; left: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem; top: 5.25rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--night-faint, #8692a9); } .ds-hours span { position: absolute; }

narrative.overview:
The site is drawn as one day. Every article is placed at the hour its habit happens (07:00, 18:30, 23:00) or marked "언제든" (anytime), and a single 24-hour line is the site's map: on the home masthead it carries the article pins and a live "지금" marker, on interior mastheads it closes the night zone as a static 00–24 scale, and on the article page it becomes the reading-progress line, segmented into 24 hours. Thumbnail card grids and image sliders are not part of this world; the index is a ruled list keyed by time.

Color owns territory rather than decorating it. Night ink owns the frame (masthead, footer, diagram plates); morning paper owns the reading column. The only active color is the sun amber, which appears where something is current, chosen, or next: the next pin, the active filter, the read portion of the progress line, the current TOC entry, the "오늘의 실행" marker. Everything else is drawn with 1px hairlines, tabular time marks, and a Korean serif for reading set against a Korean sans for interface.

The mood is calm and evidence-led, close to a quality knowledge magazine: generous leading, a 40rem reading measure, minimal rounding, no shadows, and one easing curve.
keyCharacteristics: Two zones by color: night frame, paper reading column; never a third surface family.
One active color (sun amber) with a darker text variant (sun-ink) for paper.
The 24-hour line recurs as map, masthead scale, and progress line.
1px hairlines carry structure; shadows are absent.
Tabular-figure time marks precede titles wherever an article is listed.
Serif (Hahmlet) for reading and headings, sans (Pretendard) for UI, labels, and numerals.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Amber means "active, current, or next." If an element is not in one of those states, it is not amber. Decorative amber is a defect.

rules.name: The Territory Rule
rules.body: Night owns the frame, paper owns the reading. A night surface inside the paper zone is allowed only as a plate that carries the day's own content (diagram plates, pressed states, action badges), never as a decorative band.

rules.name: The Ink-for-Text Rule
rules.body: On paper, amber text uses sun-ink; raw sun is reserved for fills, lines, and outlines.

rules.name: The Serif-Reads, Sans-Operates Rule
rules.body: If a reader reads it as content, it is Hahmlet; if they act on it or scan it as data, it is Pretendard.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every clock time is set in tabular figures so a column of times aligns.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines: ink rules open a section or list, line-color rules separate rows. Heavier strokes belong only to the 2px day-band track and progress line.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: Active marks use a 1px sun outline at 3px offset (next pin, "오늘의 실행" marker), never a glow or blurred ring.

dos: Do place every listed article behind its time mark (tabular, sun-ink on paper, sun on night) or "언제든" in muted.
Do keep amber for active, current, or next states, and use sun-ink for amber text on paper.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines: ink to open a list or section, line between rows, night-line inside the night zone.
Do keep controls at 3px and bordered containers at 4px.
Do end every article with the "오늘의 실행" list followed by the bordered disclaimer box.
Do keep reading text in Hahmlet at a 40rem measure with 1.9–1.95 leading.
Do use the single ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for the few motions, and freeze them under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce thumbnail card grids or image sliders for article listing; the ruled, time-keyed list is the index.
Don't use pill shapes or large radii.
Don't add drop shadows, glows, or blurred halos; active marks use a 1px outline at 3px offset.
Don't add a third surface family or a second accent color.
Don't set amber (sun) text on paper.
Don't set UI labels in uppercase or letter-spaced small caps.
